title: Reduction of proper base change to $\mathbf P^1$
statement:
Assume that for every scheme $S$ the projection $\mathbf P^1_S\to S$ (the scheme
$\mathbf P(\{0,1\};S)$ of [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] with its structure morphism)
satisfies $\mathrm{PBC}$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-property]. Then every proper
[def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] morphism of schemes $f:X\to Y$ satisfies $\mathrm{PBC}(f)$.

proof.text: *Reduction to an affine base.* Let $f:X\to Y$ be proper. Choose an affine open covering $Y=\bigcup_iY_i$, put $X_i=f^{-1}(Y_i)$ and let $f_i:X_i\to Y_i$ be the restriction of $f$. Each $f_i$ is the base change of $f$ along the open immersion $Y_i\hookrightarrow Y$, hence proper [lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change]. The family of open immersions $(Y_i\hookrightarrow Y)_i$ is a Zariski, hence an étale, covering of $Y$, and $\mathrm{PBC}$ is local on the target for the étale topology [lemma-weil-pbc-target-locality] (the formation of the higher direct images and of the exchange map commutes with restriction to the members of the covering). Hence $\mathrm{PBC}(f)$ follows once $\mathrm{PBC}(f_i)$ holds for every $i$, and it suffices to prove $\mathrm{PBC}(f)$ when $Y$ is affine. We assume this from now on.

source.place: Étale Cohomology, Lemma (lemma-reduce-to-P1), tag 0A4F, first paragraph (which cites Lemma, tag 03Q8, for the localization)

proof.text: *Chow's factorization.* Since $Y$ is affine and $f$ proper, [lemma-weil-pbc-chow-factorization] gives a proper surjective morphism $\pi:X'\to X$, an integer $n\ge0$ and a closed immersion $i_Y:X'\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^n_Y$ with $f\circ\pi=q_Y\circ i_Y$, where $q_Y:\mathbf P^n_Y\to Y$ is the structure morphism. Let $q_X:\mathbf P^n_X\to X$ be the structure morphism; by [lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-pullback] the square formed by $q_X$, $q_Y$, $f$ and the induced map $\mathbf P^n_X\to\mathbf P^n_Y$ is cartesian, $\mathbf P^n_X=X\times_Y\mathbf P^n_Y$, so $(\pi,i_Y)$ defines a morphism $i_X:X'\to\mathbf P^n_X$ with $q_X\circ i_X=\pi$, and $i_X$ is a closed immersion [lemma-weil-pbc-chow-embedding-over-x]. (Stacks obtains from Limits, Lemma, tag 0202, only an immersion $X'\to\mathbf P^n_Y$, and makes it closed because $X'\to Y$ is proper, Morphisms, Lemmas, tags 01W3, 01W6; [lemma-weil-pbc-chow-factorization] already states the closed immersion.)

source.place: Étale Cohomology, Lemma (lemma-reduce-to-P1), tag 0A4F, second paragraph

proof.text: *Properness of the morphisms involved.* $\mathrm{PBC}$ is defined for proper morphisms [def-weil-pbc-property], so we record: $q_X$ and $q_Y$ are proper [lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-proper]; the closed immersions $i_X$, $i_Y$ are proper [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-proper]; $\pi$ is proper by step 2; and $f\circ\pi$ is proper as a composite of proper morphisms [lem-weil-pbc-proper-composition].

source.place: Étale Cohomology, Lemma (lemma-reduce-to-P1), tag 0A4F, second paragraph ("Since $X\to Y$ is proper, we find that $X'\to Y$ is proper", Morphisms, Lemma, tag 01W3)

proof.text: *The closed immersions satisfy PBC.* The closed immersions $i_X$ and $i_Y$ are finite [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-finite], and finite morphisms satisfy $\mathrm{PBC}$ [prop-weil-pbc-finite-morphism]. Hence $\mathrm{PBC}(i_X)$ and $\mathrm{PBC}(i_Y)$.

source.place: Étale Cohomology, Lemma (lemma-reduce-to-P1), tag 0A4F, third paragraph, using Lemma (lemma-finite), tag 0A4E, and Morphisms, Lemma, tag 035C

proof.text: *The projective-space projections satisfy PBC.* By the hypothesis that $\mathbf P^1_S\to S$ satisfies $\mathrm{PBC}$ for every scheme $S$, [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-projective-space] (the symmetric-product morphism $(\mathbf P^1_T)^n\to\mathbf P^n_T$, finite and surjective, together with composition and cancellation) gives $\mathrm{PBC}$ for $\mathbf P^n_T\to T$ for every scheme $T$ and every $n\ge0$. Applied with $T=X$ and $T=Y$: $\mathrm{PBC}(q_X)$ and $\mathrm{PBC}(q_Y)$.

source.place: Étale Cohomology, Lemma (lemma-reduce-to-P1), tag 0A4F, fourth paragraph

proof.text: *Composition.* $\mathrm{PBC}$ is equivalent to $\mathrm{IA}$ for proper morphisms [lemma-weil-pbc-property-iff-acyclicity]. By steps 3–5, $i_X$ and $q_X$ are proper with $\mathrm{PBC}$, hence with $\mathrm{IA}$; by [prop-weil-pbc-composition-stability] their composite $\pi=q_X\circ i_X$ satisfies $\mathrm{IA}$ and hence $\mathrm{PBC}(\pi)$. In the same way $i_Y$ and $q_Y$ give $\mathrm{PBC}(f\circ\pi)$, since $f\circ\pi=q_Y\circ i_Y$.

source.place: Étale Cohomology, Lemma (lemma-reduce-to-P1), tag 0A4F, third paragraph, using Lemma (lemma-composition), tag 0A4D, with Lemma, tag 0A4B

proof.text: *Cancellation.* The morphisms $X'\xrightarrow{\pi}X\xrightarrow{f}Y$ are proper, $\pi$ is surjective (step 2), and $\mathrm{PBC}(\pi)$, $\mathrm{PBC}(f\circ\pi)$ hold by step 6. By [lemma-weil-pbc-cancellation], $\mathrm{PBC}(f)$ holds. With step 1 this proves $\mathrm{PBC}(f)$ for every proper $f$.

source.place: Étale Cohomology, Lemma (lemma-reduce-to-P1), tag 0A4F, third paragraph, using Lemma (lemma-sandwich), tag 0A4C

blueprint_sketch.statement:
If every projection $\mathbf P^1_S\to S$ satisfies $\mathsf{PBC}$ for every
base scheme $S$, then every proper morphism satisfies $\mathsf{PBC}$.
blueprint_sketch.proof:
Use target locality and the Chow factorization. The closed immersion
$X'\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^n_Y$ is proper and finite onto its image, so
finite base change plus composition reduces $X'\to Y$ to
$\mathbf P^n_Y\to Y$. The finite surjective map $\sigma_n$ and cancellation
reduce this projection to $(\mathbf P^1_Y)^n\to Y$. Repeated base change and
composition reduce the product projection to the one-dimensional projection.
Finally cancellation along $\pi$ transfers the property from $X'$ and
$X'\to Y$ to $X\to Y$. Every comparison used is the named exchange map of
Definition [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange].
